notes.title: Balloon Friends is Released on Steam!
notes.content:
Balloon Friends is Released on Steam!
Get your partner ready and start the game!

Since the release of the demo version, we have received a great deal of feedback and suggestions from our players. Thank you all for your support and encouragement!

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us!

notes.title: Balloon Friends playtest starts!
notes.content:
As the Chinese New Year approaches,all members of the UniTemp Game Studio wish everyone a happy family and a joyful Chinese New Year!
At this warm moment, we are pleased to launch the playtest of 'Balloon Friends'!
Please embark on this warm, happy, and romantic journey of collaboration with your partner!

You can directly choose to participate in the test on the store page.
Feedback can be submitted to the discussion group editor on the store page.
